title: 相量形式的 KVL：两个相差 120° 的电压源
statement: 两个同频电压源的“−”端接在公共结点 n（接地）：u_a(t) = 220√2 cos(100πt) V，u_b(t) = 220√2 cos(100πt − 120°) V。结点 a、b 之间接电阻 R = 100 Ω，电压表 V 并联在 R 两端。
求电压表读数、u_ab 的初相和电阻电流的有效值。

questions.ask: 电阻电流 i 的有效值 = ?

choices: U_ab = 220 − 220 = 0 V，因为两电源有效值相同
画相量图：U̇_a、−U̇_b 相差 60°，合成为 220√3∠30° V
questions.explain: KVL 对相量成立：U̇_ab = U̇_a − U̇_b，不能直接用有效值相减。两电源相位差 120°，差的模是 2 × 220 × sin60° = 220√3 V（与三相电路中“线电压 = √3 相电压、超前 30°”是同一回事）。

hints: 对回路 a → R → b → n → a 列 KVL：U̇_ab = U̇_a − U̇_b。把 U̇_b 化成代数形式再相减，或者画相量图。

en.title: KVL in phasor form: two voltage sources 120° apart
statement: Two voltage sources of the same frequency have their “−” terminals on the common node n (grounded): u_a(t) = 220√2 cos(100πt) V and u_b(t) = 220√2 cos(100πt − 120°) V. A resistor R = 100 Ω is connected between nodes a and b, with voltmeter V across it.
Find the voltmeter reading, the initial phase of u_ab and the rms current in the resistor.

questions.explain: U_ab = 330 + j190.5 has angle arctan(190.5/330) = 30°: u_ab leads u_a by 30°.

questions.ask: rms value of the resistor current i = ?
Which of these methods is wrong?
choices: U_ab = 220 − 220 = 0 V, since the two sources have the same rms value
Phasor diagram: U_a and −U_b are 60° apart, their sum is 220√3∠30° V
questions.explain: KVL holds for phasors: U_ab = U_a − U_b; rms values cannot simply be subtracted. The sources are 120° apart, so the difference has magnitude 2 × 220 × sin60° = 220√3 V (the same fact as “line voltage = √3 × phase voltage, leading by 30°” in three-phase circuits).

hints: Write the phasors U_a = 220∠0° V and U_b = 220∠−120° V.
KVL around a → R → b → n → a: U_ab = U_a − U_b. Convert U_b to rectangular form and subtract, or draw the phasor diagram.
solution: **3. Phasor diagram.** U_a and −U_b = 220∠60° have equal length and are 60° apart, so their sum lies on the bisector (30°) with length 2 × 220 × cos30° = 220√3 V.
